bullet1: Vegan leather that lasts: Tested so the finish does not peel after a few months, with a soft fabric lining inside and quality zips and hardware that stand up to daily carrying
bullet2: 22 litres, 850 grams, 30 x 17 x 42 cm: Large enough for a day at the office or a full lecture timetable, light enough that the bag itself is not the weight on your back
bullet3: Fits up to a 15.6 inch laptop: A dedicated padded compartment holds the laptop, with separate chambers on the flap and the sides for keys, a diary, a charger and the smaller things

bullet5: Water resistant, not waterproof: The leather sheds light rain and splashes. The zips themselves are not sealed, so it is not built for a downpour

short_title: Meyaar Card Holder Compatible with MagSafe
bullet1: Compatibility: Compatible with iPhone models that have built in magnets, and with cases made for MagSafe; it snaps on through the case and lifts off whenever you want to charge wirelessly
bullet2: Not only for iPhone: Two stick on magnet rings sit in the box, so the holder is compatible with Samsung, Google Pixel, OnePlus, Vivo, Oppo and Realme phones and with any case that has no magnets of its own
bullet3: Smart card storage: Slim enough to forget, roomy enough for three cards such as a bank card, Aadhaar, PAN, driving licence or an office ID; a thumb push slot slides one out one handed, and it lifts off to use on its own
bullet4: N52 magnets and RFID shielding: N52 grade magnets set in a full ring grip across the whole footprint rather than one weak centre point, and a shielding layer inside blocks unauthorised scans of your card data
bullet5: In the box: One card holder and two stick on magnet rings; available in Black, Blue, White and Light Brown
description: Your phone already goes everywhere. This makes your cards go with it, and it is not only for iPhone. The Meyaar 3 Card Holder attaches to the back of your phone and carries three cards, so your metro card, your office ID and a bank card travel together instead of one ending up loose in a pocket. A thumb push slot in the base lets you slide a card out one handed, without taking the holder off the phone. TWO MAGNET RINGS TURN ANY PHONE MAGNETIC This is the part most card holders leave out. Every pack includes two peel and stick magnet rings. If your phone already has built in magnets it attaches straight on. If it does not, an older model or a thick case that weakens the pull, stick a ring on the back of the phone or the case and it grips exactly as firmly. Two rings means you can set up two phones, or keep a spare for when you change cases. N52 MAGNETS AND RFID SHIELDING The magnets are N52 grade, the strongest commonly available, and they sit in a full ring rather than a single point in the centre, so the holder grips across its whole footprint and survives being pulled in and out of jeans, a bag or a jacket. Inside, a shielding layer blocks unauthorised RFID scans, so nobody reads your card data out of your pocket in a crowd. SLIM ENOUGH TO FORGET Stitched PU leather keeps the profile close to the phone, so it still drops into a front pocket. Lift it off and your phone charges wirelessly as normal, or carry it on its own as a standalone card holder. IN THE BOX 1 x Card Holder 2 x Stick On Magnet Rings

bullet2: COMPATIBLE WITH IPHONE 12 THROUGH 18: Every Pro, Pro Max, Plus, mini and Air in those generations snaps on directly, with or without a case. Older iPhones use an included ring.
bullet3: COMPATIBLE WITH SAMSUNG, GOOGLE PIXEL AND MORE: Galaxy S and Z series, Pixel, OnePlus, Vivo, Oppo, Realme, Nothing, Motorola and Xiaomi all work with a stick-on ring. One wallet for the house.
bullet4: HOLDS 3 CARDS, NOT 2: Metro card, office ID and a bank card all travel together instead of one living loose in a pocket. Push them out one-handed with a thumb through the side cutout.
bullet5: STAYS PUT, STAYS SLIM: Magnets grip in a full ring rather than one weak centre point, so it survives jeans, bags and jackets. Stitched PU leather in Black, White, Blue, Pink and Light Brown.
description: Your phone already goes everywhere. This makes your cards go with it — and it is not just for iPhone. The Meyaar 3-Card Magnetic Wallet snaps onto the back of your phone and holds three cards: your metro card, your office ID and a bank card, so none of them ends up loose in a pocket. A cutout on the side lets you push cards out with your thumb, one-handed, without taking the wallet off. TWO MAGNET RINGS MAKE ANY PHONE MAGNETIC This is the part most card wallets leave out. Every pack includes two peel-and-stick magnet rings. If your phone already has built-in magnets, the wallet snaps straight on. If it doesn't — an Android, an older iPhone, or a thick case that weakens the pull — stick a ring on the back of the phone or case and it grips exactly as firmly. Two rings means you can set up two phones, or keep a spare when you change cases. COMPATIBLE WITH ALMOST EVERY PHONE Compatible with iPhone 12, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17 and 18 series — every Pro, Pro Max, Plus, mini and Air — which snap on directly, with or without a case. Compatible with Samsung Galaxy S and Z series, Google Pixel, OnePlus, Vivo, Oppo, Realme, Nothing, Motorola, Xiaomi, iQOO, Poco and older iPhones using one of the two rings in the box. BUILT TO STAY ON The magnets run as a full ring rather than a single weak point in the centre, so the wallet grips across its whole footprint. It survives being pulled in and out of jeans, a bag or a jacket without creeping down the back of the phone. SLIM ENOUGH TO FORGET Stitched PU leather keeps the profile close to the phone, so it still drops into a front pocket. Lift it off and your phone charges wirelessly as normal. IN THE BOX 1 x Card Wallet 2 x Stick-On Magnet Rings

description: Your phone already goes everywhere. This makes your cards go with it — and it is not just for iPhone. The Meyaar 3-Card Magnetic Wallet snaps onto the back of your phone and holds three cards: your metro card, your office ID and a bank card, so none of them ends up loose in a pocket. A cutout on the side lets you push cards out with your thumb, one-handed, without taking the wallet off. TWO MAGNET RINGS MAKE ANY PHONE MAGNETIC This is the part most card wallets leave out. Every pack includes two peel-and-stick magnet rings. If your phone already has built-in magnets, the wallet snaps straight on. If it doesn't — an Android, an older iPhone, or a thick case that weakens the pull — stick a ring on the back of the phone or case and it grips exactly as firmly. Two rings means you can set up two phones, or keep a spare when you change cases. COMPATIBLE WITH ALMOST EVERY PHONE Compatible with iPhone 12, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17 and 18 series — every Pro, Pro Max, Plus, mini and Air — which snap on directly, with or without a case. Compatible with Samsung Galaxy S and Z series, Google Pixel, OnePlus, Vivo, Oppo, Realme, Nothing, Motorola, Xiaomi, iQOO, Poco and older iPhones using one of the two rings in the box. BUILT TO STAY ON The magnets run as a full ring rather than a single weak point in the centre, so the wallet grips across its whole footprint. It survives being pulled in and out of jeans, a bag or a jacket without creeping down the back of the phone. SLIM ENOUGH TO FORGET Stitched PU leather keeps the profile close to the phone, so it still drops into a front pocket. Lift it off and your phone charges wirelessly as normal. IN THE BOX 1 x Card Wallet 2 x Stick-On Magnet Rings
